about: Which specimen draws each option and enumerated value of vis-network-vocabulary.json (at most a few named each), or why none can; written by vis-network.mjs.

nodes.borderWidthSelected.notDrawn: selection only: the border width of a selected node

nodes.chosen.notDrawn: interaction only: how a node changes when selected or hovered (a boolean or a function)

nodes.color.highlight.notDrawn: selection only: the colors of a selected node

nodes.color.hover.notDrawn: hover only: the colors of a node under the pointer

nodes.fixed.notDrawn: physics only: whether the simulation may move the node

nodes.id.notDrawn: structural: the node's id (every specimen has one; ids are the specimen ids)

nodes.image.selected.notDrawn: selection only: the image of a selected node

nodes.labelHighlightBold.notDrawn: selection only: a selected node's label turns bold

nodes.level.notDrawn: hierarchical layout only: the level a hierarchical layout puts the node on; the sheets store positions

nodes.scaling.customScalingFunction.notDrawn: a JavaScript function; a document cannot hold one

custom.notDrawn: draws with nodes.ctxRenderer, a function a document cannot hold

nodes.ctxRenderer.notDrawn: a JavaScript function (the custom shape's renderer); a document cannot hold one, so a file cannot draw it

nodes.title.notDrawn: tooltip only: HTML shown on hover

nodes.x.notDrawn: position: every specimen stores one (covered by every sheet)

nodes.y.notDrawn: position: every specimen stores one (covered by every sheet)

edges.chosen.notDrawn: interaction only: how an edge changes when selected or hovered

edges.color.highlight.notDrawn: selection only: the color of a selected edge

edges.color.hover.notDrawn: hover only: the color of an edge under the pointer

edges.hoverWidth.notDrawn: hover only: extra width under the pointer

edges.labelHighlightBold.notDrawn: selection only: a selected edge's label turns bold

edges.scaling.customScalingFunction.notDrawn: a JavaScript function; a document cannot hold one

edges.selectionWidth.notDrawn: selection only: extra width of a selected edge

configure.notDrawn: DOM only: the option editor vis-network builds next to the canvas

interaction.notDrawn: interaction only (drag, zoom, hover, navigation buttons as DOM elements, keyboard, tooltips)

layout.notDrawn: layout only: the sheets store positions and turn physics off (a hierarchical layout would move them)

physics.notDrawn: physics only; every sheet sets physics: false so the stored positions stand

autoResize.notDrawn: DOM only: whether the canvas follows its container's size

locale.notDrawn: DOM only: the language of the edit toolbar

locales.notDrawn: DOM only: the edit toolbar's strings

height.notDrawn: DOM only: the canvas element's CSS height (the oracle draws 1200 x 900)

width.notDrawn: DOM only: the canvas element's CSS width (the oracle draws 1200 x 900)
